# Binks Stonevein

> **Background:** Outlander
> **Level:** ⚠️ **6, per S25.5** — *"You're going to be empowered to above and beyond level six."* 🛑 **NOT propagated as settled.** [[Session 24 — Go Away, Demogorgon]] records **level 5, party-wide**, and if the numbering question resolves toward "S25.5 is the tail of the S25 play night," the level-up belongs to **S25**, not to a separate session. See the session note's Continuity Flag 17.

## Description / Appearance

- Very small gnome; blends in with the rocks and caverns due to dirty clothes (S02)
- Bald-headed, stone-colored skin, white goatee (S02)
- Bright smile despite circumstances (S02)
- Movement speed: 25ft (S02)
- (S25.5) 🛑 **His body is turning drow-ward, and it is the most vivid material in the session.** He runs **colder** and *"a little bit more grayish bluish."* **Grey-blue mottling is spreading from the base of his spine** — Addison workshopped the origin point live, moving it from the back of the ears to the heart before settling: *"Actually, that's not true. I'm gonna say it's starting at the base of your spine."* The skin there is rough: *"Furry. And it hurts and itches."* His **canines are visibly sharpened** (*"oh, these are sharper"*). The roughening is a deliberate callback to *"the same kind of thing that [[Darby Stonefeather|Darby]] felt when he picked you up."* Addison's shorthand, twice: *"it's a little bit like Spider-Man. Spider-Man."* — [[Session 25.5 — Sucks to Suck, Nerd|S25.5]]
- (S25.5) **Sunlight sensitivity *and* sensitivity to bright moonlight** — *"you specifically have sunlight sensitivity, and you also have sensitivity to bright moonlight."* ⚠️ `bright moonlight` is a 50–60% confidence correction of `block moonlight`. Currently costless underground; **it becomes a real problem the day the party surfaces.** — [[Session 25.5 — Sucks to Suck, Nerd|S25.5]]
- (S25.5) His new **bite** carries a taste **only he perceives**: *"this arachnid, tangy, acidic, kind of like lemon juice."* — [[Session 25.5 — Sucks to Suck, Nerd|S25.5]]

Which stance will take you?"*** (explicitly **not** a magical effect). A **WIS save of 16 avoided a madness point** — his third dodge; the count stays at 1. A forced **Religion 19** made a distant surge retreat and **diminished** his connection to the Velkynvelve act — he was "protected from something that would have been very, very bad" — but it went **dormant, not away**, and he realised he had been seeing through **arachnid eyes**. In the morning he woke [[Darby Stonefeather]] ("get your spider and keep her away from me"), gathered everyone and cast **Zone of Truth** (15-ft radius, DC 14) — then **failed his own spell**, caught attempting "I am not possessed." Asked *"Am I talking to Binks?"* he answered **"No"**, then clarified: ⭐ **his real name is not Binks** — *"I'm not the guy that I named myself after. I've been the same person through and through."* First confirmation the name is assumed. ⚠️ **[[Derendil]] passed the save, and only Binks knew it.**

Opened the chuul ambush with a **2nd-level Guiding Bolt for 20**. After [[Derendil]]'s frenzy dropped [[Kit Aluri]] to 0, he **topped her back up for 9** behind [[Blarg]]'s Cure Wounds.
- **[[Session 18 — Trust the Whirlpool|Session 18]]:** Steered from [[Roxy]]'s horns through the river run and **spotted the mid-channel boulder — and the "mermaid" standing on top of it — too late** (Perception 18), shouting to ask [[Sloopidoop]] whether mermaids are friendly (*"I do not think so"*) and then simply "Boulder!" ⭐ **His Guiding Bolt is what won the fight.** Cast with advantage on the grappled hag for **16 damage**, it **dropped her Disguise Self** and left her glowing for the next attacker — which set up [[Kit Aluri]]'s natural-20 killing leap. Took 7 bludgeoning in the whirlpool and ended the session at a point of exhaustion.
- **[[Session 19 — We Are Split in Two|Session 19]]:** ⭐ **Talked the party out of a battle.** Ashore and surrounded by nine hostile kuo-toa, he used **Thaumaturgy to project his voice**, apologised for the intrusion, and invoked [[Sloopidoop]]'s name and the token he had been given — **Persuasion with disadvantage, ~23 even after exhaustion** — then backed it with a **second Persuasion of 21** aided by Heroic Inspiration, which got two of the four remaining guards to stand down. The party was escorted in hostile but unharmed. Inside the netting gate, when [[Indigo]]'s faction ambushed their captors, he **cast Invisibility to slip away and was caught anyway** — ⚠️ **the kuo-toa here can sense invisible creatures**, which is new tactical information. Rolled history on [[Bregan D'aerthe]] during the [[Artaxle]] flashback. At the cliffhanger he volunteered instantly to go in as bait — *"I love trickery — yes, I'll do it"* — leaving one bystander with a cryptic parting whisper: *"it was the little statue."*
- **[[Session 20 — Not My Circus, Not My Demogorgon|Session 20]]:** **Insight 23** on the bound duergar read him as a smuggler-trader who had walked into the wrong town after the Deep Father faction rose — later revealed as **[[Hemeth]]**. In round one he **channelled divinity to create an illusory duplicate of himself atop the shrine**, making "the most obscene gestures" as a distraction (a combined Deception/Performance reported as 39 — the numbers are garbled but it was ruled a success): whips and monitors turned toward the double, and **it survived a monitor's bite.** He then slipped behind [[Derendil]]. In round two he cast **Bless on [[Darby Stonefeather]], [[Amanita de'Champignon]] and [[Aeolus]]** through a window. At the hard stop, **down to a single spell slot**, he floated desecrating the ritual and a gloriously cheeky **Ceremony** gambit to turn the lake around [[Demogorgon]] into holy water — Addison: *"That'd be like a DC 30 Religion check."* On the escape route he was unequivocal: ***"I ain't splitting the party."***
- **[[Session 21 — The Shield and the Middle Finger|Session 21]]:** Took a **fourth Cleric level and the Skill Expert feat** (expertise in Insight, proficiency in Deception), then prayed out loud — *"Please, give me wit. Give me cleverness, [[Garl Glittergold|Garl]]"* — and rolled a **31 on a combined Religion+Insight check**. Addison **tripled his stunt doubles, made them semi-corporeal and golden, and able to speak through him.** He went first in the carried-over initiative and used **Thaumaturgy through all his duplicates** to boom an evacuation order in Undercommon across the whole town — *"Sloobludop is lost. The demon is coming to destroy this place… Your lives are more important. We have to leave"* — then followed it with a **26 Persuasion**, and the town started running. His persuasion to bring [[Jimjar]] and [[Hemeth]] along **failed**. The tidal wave flung him into a dock for **10 bludgeoning**. 🛑 **The session's centrepiece is his.** He hung back at the mist line to watch [[Sloobludop]] die — *"the second town he held in his heart that has been destroyed"* — and said a prayer for the kuo-toa dead. **He rolled an 8.** Addison had built the moment so the party could help him; [[Kit Aluri]] passed the high-DC Perception needed to notice, refused to name a god, and cleared **DC 30** on his behalf — and **his last remaining duplicate solidified into a golden shrine to [[Garl Glittergold]]** wearing Binks's own face, posture and robes, holding a shield out toward [[Demogorgon]] and humming in a low sing-song voice that reminded him of *Kit*. **He immediately added a raised middle finger to the statue's other hand.** Addison noted there may be consequences later. Rolled a **dirty 20 on History** for the full [[04-World-Lore/Locations/Mantol-Derith]] briefing (⚠️ a *total* of 20 — natural 18; see [[Roll Statistics S16-S25]]). Scavenged and patched the second hull with [[Blarg]]'s help and guidance. **Rolled a natural 1 on the bone-teeth group Dexterity check** — *"Don't worry, I'm kind of an anchor"* — and went over the side into the whirlpool; [[Indigo]] surfaced and hauled him back aboard. ✅ **27 DDB archive rows — the session's heaviest**, but ⚠️ **inflated by [[Topsy]]/[[Turvy]] proxy saves** rolled on Matt's account as composite `2d20` customs.
- **[[Session 22 — Blind Faith in a Hunter's Mark|Session 22]]:** Opened above the table having **reconciled the party inventory on D&D Beyond** — 1,800 gp including the platinum, a string of pearls and healing potions, deliberately left undivided: *"it's a communist party at this point. We're all sharing."* Read [[Nanny Plunk]] on **Insight 25**: threat level very high, her hurt and anger a **deliberate affect**, and — the detail that mattered — **she is alone**, which hags are not. When [[Indigo]] finally admitted the cove held innocent merfolk and Tritons, Binks landed the session's first big laugh: *"you really buried the lead there. If you would have just led with that, we would not been having this conversation."*
  In combat his **Spiritual Weapon** was established on-air as **an actual lute** played like an electric guitar — Addison: *"It's not a pick. It is an actual lute."* It missed in round one and *"bangs onto the rock and just emits this BANGING electrical riff,"* then hit for 8 in round two behind a 2nd-level **Guiding Bolt**. He stated his objective plainly: ***"My goal is to kill Nanny Plunk."***
  **Then he became the weapon against his own friend.** The hags shimmered and [[Kit Aluri]] saw two of him; when she asked how many there were, he answered *"Currently? There's two. The one behind the hag and the one me"* — and both Binkses replied to her telepathically at once through the Rapport Spores, which is precisely what made the illusion convincing. Told she was about to be stabbed, he said only ***"Do it."*** After she killed the hag through the illusory copy and turned to him with *"your Binks,"* **he flipped her off.** Then, unprompted, he walked over to check on her, recognised the short-term madness behind her questions, made a joke of it — *"well, at least you got her. But I don't really like you not laughing about it"* — and cast ***Tasha's Hideous Laughter*** on her to stop her attacking anyone. **That is the closing image of the session.** ✅ 11 DDB archive rolls cross-referenced.

### S25 Key Events ([[Session 25 — Nevermind. We're Going|Session 25]])

> 🛑 **READ THIS FIRST — the S25 outcome was flagged for a possible retcon ON AIR, and this entry is written around that.**
> Addison said, **in the act of setting the ruling that destroyed the ring**: *"I may need to. We may need to retcon this. Okay. Straight up… It's about the Ring of Mind shielding itself and the destruction of magical I items. So this may need to change."* He then asked Matt to **stay after the session** to *"hash some things out."* Per the Convo 1 handoff, the six blocked outcomes below were **not to be written as canon** until Taylor confirms.
> ⚠️ **They are recorded here anyway, explicitly marked as pending, for one reason:** [[Session 25.5 — Sucks to Suck, Nerd]] — the post-play administration block from the **same night** — proceeds as though the change **stood**, and this page's S25.5 sections already rebuild him as a Hexblade Warlock on that basis. **Leaving S25 silent would leave the page explaining a rebuild with no cause.** That is strong circumstantial evidence, **not** confirmation. **Nothing below has been entered into the frontmatter, the class roster, the party table or the [[Loot Tracker S16-S25|Loot Tracker]] on the strength of S25 alone.**

**He is back at the table after missing S24** — *"I was on an airplane last session"* — and he spends the session doing, deliberately, the most consequential thing any player has done in the campaign.

- **The comic opening.** Tried to light the webbing off [[Darby Stonefeather]] with a tinderbox at disadvantage — *"Nope, they don't light"* — then with flint and steel at a higher DC, and rolled a **natural 1**: *"you don't got it. You got nothing. You cut your own finger."* **Takes 2 slashing damage.** When [[Aeolus]]'s spark became a fireball he made his **Dexterity save at 21**, *"just barely"* — *"You singe your eyebrows, but you don't take any damage."* Passed his **madness save at 16**, remarking *"man, this ring of mind shielding really helps."* ⚠️ In hindsight, that line is the session in miniature. He also requested the **war room** that Addison then folded into the bastion redesign: *"We need a war room."*
- **He plans it over the break, out loud, and is warned off.** He told [[Blarg]] he wanted to talk to **[[Lolth]]** — *"She's been on my ass… maybe bridge the gap here. We got spider webs"* — reasoning that [[Demogorgon]] is bad for her too, that the demon is *"encroaching on her territory,"* and *"what's the worst that happens? She tries to kill me again."* He framed it as attempt three: *"she hasn't got me yet, so might as well keep trying it."* His own summary of his arc: ***"I'm trying to get the infinity stones of pissing off gods."*** [[Blarg]] warned him off in character and out of it. He went anyway.
- 🏆 **The negotiation, and it is a masterpiece of good instincts and bad promises.** He acknowledged seeing through spiders' eyes, named [[Demogorgon]] as a shared enemy (*"Demogorgon is bad for all of us"*), offered **reparations** and service, asked her to call the spiders off the bastion, and said *"I don't want you to kill me. And I want help."* ⭐ **Then he refused to lie to her:** *"I won't desecrate any more your shrines, maybe. **I'm not gonna promise that. Actually, I can't promise that.** It's real funny."* He cleared the **persuasion — a "dirty 20" of 21 — by spending heroic inspiration**, the one roll in the sequence he passed. [[Blarg]]'s verdict: *"What a negotiation. Beautiful."* Addison awarded him **heroic inspiration** *"to honor your character."* ⚠️ **What he actually promised is undefined even to him:** *"I don't think I offered full service, but yeah, we'll see."* 🛑 **Whether the spider request was granted is never stated.**
- 🛑 **Addison stopped the game and refused to rule alone.** *"We need to pause. Time stops in the. In the game. We're above table here, guys."* He admitted he had thought Matt was joking and had been playing along, cited his therapist on being honest with his friends, and put it to a **democratic thumbs-up/thumbs-down vote**: ***"I'm going to make this a democratic vote. I cannot rule this because we're a team."*** [[Darby Stonefeather]] pro, [[Blarg]] pro on agency grounds, [[Kit Aluri]] voted dream. **The table let it stand.** Addison: *"this is the second time you've surprised me as a table. The most surprised I've been since you decided to go back to [[Velkynvelve]]."*
- **The rolls, and they are unambiguous.** Keeping the **Ring of Mind Shielding** intact was priced at a **DC 30 spellcasting check plus a DC 20 Intelligence save.** He called it up front — *"It's also impossible unless I hit a natural 20 for the 30"* — and **failed both.** Then **99 on the d100**: long-term madness, *"Player falls unconscious. No amount of jostling or damage can wake the character,"* duration **d10 × 10 hours**. ⚠️ **The d10 was never rolled on record.** His line going in: *"Let's see where the dice lie. Yeah, let's see where it takes us."*
- 🛑 **Magical darkness swallowed him** — a 40-foot sphere Addison called *"very powerful and literally impregnable"* and [[Blarg]]'s natural-20 arcana identified as **drow magic** *"far more powerful than it should be."* His last sensation was *"your loot pick shattering in front of your eyes."* **Inside the dream he killed every one of his friends**, and then [[Clementine]] stood over [[Darby Stonefeather]]'s corpse and grew until he was the tiny spider beneath her claw. **[[Lolth]] spoke** — playful, delighted, dismissive: ***"You are cute. It is really adorable because you truly. You understand nothing, my dear… caught in a web that I didn't even know that I had laid out. I'm barely paying attention to you, my child."*** ⭐ **She then turned, said *"What is that?"*, and was gone** — driven off by [[Kit Aluri]]'s orcish magic, which he does not know about and nobody has told him.
- **He wakes up awake and paralysed**, speech reduced to *"a bunch of garbled nonsense"* — Addison compared it directly to his own recent injury. **Strength check 11 at disadvantage, failed:** *"You cannot move. You are not in pain, but you cannot move… you are awake, but you are paralyzed."* A **history 19** left him remembering *"bits and pieces"* of who Binks was. ⚠️ **His perception/insight rolls do not reconcile** — transcribed as *"Perception 30. 20,"* and Addison later asked *"What was the 30 insight for?"* though **no insight check was ever called for on record.** Most likely the same 30 relabelled; **unresolved.** [[Blarg]] healed him for **24** with a third-level Cure Wounds; [[Amanita de'Champignon]] broke the paralysis with **Lesser Restoration**; [[Darby Stonefeather]] carried him out and found him **lighter than expected, cold, clammy, faintly bristly.**
- **He takes it with total equanimity, which is the most Binks thing in the session.** *"Well, I f---ed up. So that's on me, that one."* / *"I don't think I derailed the campaign, but if I did, my bad."* / *"Something exciting needed to happen."* / ⭐ ***"I'm a big fan of consequences and I'm the one that's been doing the dumbest stuff and pushing the boundaries."*** On his loot: *"It was a nice mute button on the spores if it got too loud."* Asked what he wanted to look like afterwards: *"I'm gonna say not much change right now, but I've got things. I got ideas."* [[Blarg]] on the cost: *"With the character as well. It's perfect."*
- 🛑 **THE SIX BLOCKED OUTCOMES — recorded, NOT ratified.** Per the session note: the **Ring of Mind Shielding destroyed** (*"shattered to dust atoms… atomized"*); the **[[Garl Glittergold]] connection severed** (*"kiss Garl goodbye. Garl's gone… So you are no longer a cleric"*); **[[Lolth]] installed as warlock patron**, confirmed on a 30 insight and framed as *"temporary… as long as you want it to be"*; the **rename** — *"You're still [[Ormic]], but you're no longer Binks… You're Ormic the Warlock"*, with Matt instructed to **copy** the sheet rather than delete it; an **alignment shift** from chaotic good toward *"a lot more chaotic neutral"*; and **two levels of exhaustion** (d20 checks **−6**, speed **−15** until a long rest; normal speed 25 → 10 unaided, 20 with help, 25 if [[Darby Stonefeather]] carries him). Addison's stated reason for her mercy: *"She powered you up because you specifically asked for help and reparations and she thinks it's funny that you care about the drow because she does not."* **See the banner at the top of this entry. Taylor's confirmation converts all six into canon in one step.**
- ⚠️ **Zero DDB archive rows this session** — plausible for him (last archive appearance 2026-08-16). Every roll above is transcript-confirmed only.

### S25.5 Key Events ([[Session 25.5 — Sucks to Suck, Nerd]])

> 🛑 **Numbering unresolved** — on-disk `Session 25.5`, frontmatter `session_number: 27`, transcript byte-identical to S26's. Reads as the **post-break tail of the S25 play night.** If it folds into S25, this whole entry merges there.
>
> ⚠️ **There is no in-fiction scene in this segment.** It is a 20-minute post-play level-up and D&D Beyond administration block — zero combat, zero initiative, no NPC voiced. **Canon arrives entirely as the DM explaining mechanics to players by their real names.** Ormic is the active party throughout.

- ⭐ **He is rebuilt as a Hexblade Warlock patroned by [[Lolth]], and the pact is made material.** Reworking his build he landed on Warlock over the alternative — *"I'm realizing the idea for what I wanted is actually working better with Warlock, Which is weird"* — and with his single Rogue level already banked, settled it: *"So then it just makes more sense to be a Hexblade Warlock. To do hex plus Sneak Attack, I become stronger."* A brief false alarm about whether he could be a Rogue was retracted instantly (*"Oh, you already had rogue, My bad"*).
- **A Persuasion check scaled the reward, and the table produced three numbers for it.** Addison asked for the earlier result; *"30"* and *"20"* came back-to-back from two speaker labels and were **never reconciled**. A fresh check was called; he spent **Heroic Inspiration**; Addison reported *"you rolled a 3 and it was still an 11, so… it's pretty neutral, but yes."* ⭐ **That 11 is what capped the sword at +1** — *"No other damage modifiers. Dot, dot, dot yet."* (See the session note's Continuity Flag 5.)
- 🛑 **THE CURSED SWORD — the session's core canon.** His short sword fused with his **Pact Weapon**: *"Along with this Pact Weapon, it becomes this cursed weapon."* Terms as ruled: *"You are not able to rid yourself of the sword"*; it is not bound to his hand, but *"if you try to leave it or destroy it, it will only hurt you"*; abandoning it means *"you will be compelled to go back… You'll essentially be charmed into going back"*; and **it returns to him at any distance.** He reframed the whole thing as a perk: *"To benefit that I have the one that the sword will return to me, no matter how far it is."*
- 🛑 **[[Lolth's Lieutenants]] now speak to him through the sword.** Addison was careful with the theology, correcting himself mid-sentence to establish it is **not** the goddess directly — *"Not Lolth. She has these special minions"* — and then **explicitly declined to name them**: *"I can't remember their names right off the top of my head."* **No order has been relayed yet.** The pipe exists; it has not been used.
- ⭐ **His destroyed focus is reforged from its own remains, and the protection is preserved so the exception can bite.** *"your focus is a new basically from. From the shards and ash of your old spellcasting focus. Your old lute pick is a new lute pick"* — now *"much more necrotic and purple."* It **keeps the [[Ring of Mind Shielding]] effects in full**, with exactly one hole: *"But the only one who can override it at her will is… Lolth. Sucks to suck. Nerd."* **The session takes its title from that sentence.**
- **New abilities, stacked and hedged:** a **bite** (Strength to hit; **1d6 poison + 1d4 piercing** after Addison cut it live from 1d8 poison), and a **once-per-day, mutually exclusive** kit of **Darkness + Faerie Fire** *or* **Spider Climb** — *"if you use Spider Climb, you cannot cast darkness and or Faerie Fire"* — issued *"Along with some consequences"* that were never specified.
- 🛑 **His body starts turning drow-ward, and Addison spends the longest single stretch of the segment on it.** Colder, *"a little bit more grayish bluish"*, **grey-blue mottling spreading from the base of his spine** where the skin is rough, *"Furry. And it hurts and itches"*; **canines sharpened**; **sunlight and bright-moonlight sensitivity.** A sensory callback to *"the same kind of thing that [[Darby Stonefeather|Darby]] felt when he picked you up."* Addison twice: *"it's a little bit like Spider-Man."* ⭐ **The narrated detail is firmer than the numbers** — he revised the mottling's origin point (ears → heart → spine) and the bite damage on air, but retracted no description.
- ⭐ **[[Blarg]] moved immediately to undo it, at his own cost, and was told *not yet* rather than *no*.** *"since your alignment has changed, Matthew, can I atonement you right back basically with Ceremony?"* On a **Religion 19**: *"it would be ill advised to try to… At least this early on in the process. This fresh. It's very fresh."* Blarg stood down voluntarily. **The atonement route stays live, gated on elapsed time.** Ormic's dry read on his patron's reach: *"Her energy is kind of everywhere."*
- **His old god is asked about twice and answers nothing.** *"I mean, will Garl take me back? Great questions"* and *"Will Garl take a warlock? That's a question."* [[Garl Glittergold]]'s standing with him is **[Unknown/Ambiguous]**. Taylor answered for the god in jest — *"Garl can take a dick"* — and Ormic's reply was the softer one: *"Garl's a great guy. He might find it very funny."*
- **Addison stated the ownership as fact and the difficulty as near-total.** *"one positive is that it's unlikely that Lolth will try to charm you or dominate you now because she knows that your soul is essentially hers until you find some way of purging her"*, and *"getting rid of a patron as a warlock. Especially when your patron is literally a goddess."* His own summary of the trade: ***"I can hex. So that's great."***
- ⚠️ **He may be absent next session** — *"I might not be able to make it next session because I'll be traveling from Florida."* Asked to post it in the Discord schedule thread. **Above-table logistics, not canon.**
- **Fey Touched confirmed retained** through the class change. ⚠️ **The 300 ft Fey Step + Thunderwave boon granted in the same stretch is NOT recorded as his** — the recipient is unresolved between him and [[Kit Aluri]]. See the session note's Continuity Flag 3.
- ⚠️ **Zero DDB archive rows** — the archive was not queried in this run, and all three of the session's rolls were physical dice. **Zero rows is the expected result, not a gap.**

- First watch with [[Topsy]] (Perception 16; flat d20 **nat 20**) — spotted [[Violet Fungus|violet fungi]] flashing purple in the distance.
- **The dream escalated:** revealed he's had restless dreams since the shrine desecration (glades, family with dead eyes, flying through passages). Tonight: skittering through tunnels as something arachnid, toward "the one that created this disruption" — a molten, reshaping shrine of "conflicting divine power" — climbed his target and saw **his own face**. Woke with [[Clementine]] on his shoulder "as if waiting." Voice in his head: **"What stand will you take? Which stance will take you?"**
- WIS save 16 — **avoided a third madness point** (count stays at 1). Forced Religion check **19**: connection to the Velkynvelve act diminished — "protected from something that would have been very, very bad" — but it went **dormant, not away**. He was seeing through arachnid eyes.
- Woke Darby: "Get your spider and keep her away from me."

Ormic." — confirmed a genuine tease, not a mishear; see the S21 reveal below once that note is written. Spelling normalized from *Ormik* per Taylor's ruling 2026-08-16.)

### S21 Key Events ([[Session 21 — The Shield and the Middle Finger|Session 21]])

- **Took his 4th Cleric level** in the opening round, mid-catastrophe, plus the **Skill Expert** feat: **expertise in Insight, proficiency in Deception.** Party-wide level 5.
- **Prayed out loud before doing anything else** — *"Please, give me wit. Give me cleverness, Garl"* — and rolled a combined **Religion + Insight 31** (natural 18, +2 +11). Addison: "You beat a 30, dude." Reward: his **stunt doubles tripled to three**, made **golden, semi-corporeal** (able to interact physically) and **able to speak through him**. Permanent upgrade.
- **Evacuated an entire town in one action.** Cast **Thaumaturgy** through all three duplicates simultaneously to boom an order in Undercommon across [[Sloobludop]]: *"Sloobludop is lost. The demon is coming to destroy this place… Your lives are more important. We have to leave. Go."* Spellcasting roll **20**, followed by a **26 Persuasion** at advantage. The town started running; [[Ploop]] reinforced it in Undercommon.
- **Failed the persuasion to keep [[Jimjar]] and [[Hemeth]] with the party** (two DCs, one roll). Both took the overland tunnels northeast and are now separated with no reunion plan.
- **Ran hot and cold to an extreme degree.** Group Stealth 28 and a dirty-20 History on [[04-World-Lore/Locations/Mantol-Derith]] bracket a **failed Dex save vs. the tidal wave (10 bludgeoning, flung into a dock)**, an **8 on the prayer for the kuo-toa dead**, and a **natural 1** on the bone-teeth Dex check that put him over the side into a whirlpool — *"Don't worry, I'm kind of an anchor."* [[Indigo]] hauled him back aboard (Athletics 20 with advantage). His own summary: *"I keep doing dumb stuff, but hey, madness doesn't touch me."*
- **Passed the DC 12 madness save at disadvantage, on a 19.** Still the party's lone madness-carrier; count remains 1.
- 🏆 **The session's centrepiece.** Hung back alone at the mist line to watch Sloobludop die and say a prayer for the kuo-toa — "the second town he held in his heart that has been destroyed" — and **rolled an 8**. Addison had built the moment so the party could assist; [[Kit Aluri]] noticed (Perception 19), refused to name a god, and made a blind reach for "whoever would have its eyes on Binks," clearing **DC 30 with a 36**. **Binks's last remaining duplicate solidified into a golden shrine to [[Garl Glittergold]]** — wearing *Binks's own face, posture and robes* — holding a shield out toward [[Demogorgon]] and **humming in a low sing-song voice that reminded him of Kit.** He immediately added a **raised middle finger** to the statue's other hand. A wave of protection rolled out of the city; Demogorgon visibly paused. Addison: *"There may be consequences for that later."* Binks: *"but, ah, it's fine."*
- **Dirty-20 History on [[04-World-Lore/Locations/Mantol-Derith]]** delivered the session's whole lore briefing: a centuries-old neutral outpost carved into a pillar from cavern ceiling to waterline with waterfalls, ~140 people, chilly and damp, lit by continual flame and light-reflecting crystals, crushed-crystal plazas, an informal council of four chief negotiators (drow, duergar, human, svirfneblin), surface trade dominated by the [[Zhentarim]] with a "black network" beneath.
- **Set the party's new objective:** *"We need to get to a city like asap. We need to warn people. That's goal number one."*
- Scavenged the second hull with [[Blarg]]'s help and guidance (**Survival 18** — "not a pristine success, but it is success"), and cast a **2nd-level Bless** on the four lowest-Strength party members for the bone-teeth crossing.
- ✅ **27 DDB archive rolls** — he rolled digitally this session. ⚠️ Three of those rows are composite `2d20` **[[Topsy]]/[[Turvy]] proxy saves** on Matt's account, not Binks's own (see [[Roll Statistics S16-S25]]). Note also that the archive logs **Kit's DC-30 Religion check on Binks's account** (`1d20+2 = 21` at 14:25) — the die was Matt's, the action was Kit's.
